meta.title: Tivren Timesheet · For freelancers on Mac and Windows

hero.title: Timesheets for freelancers,
hero.lead: Log the days you work for each client, take days off, and send a monthly timesheet as Excel or PDF. Bank holidays are applied for you. Everything stays on your computer.
hero.appAlt: Tivren Timesheet's calendar: the month's summary with hours worked and pay earned, today's check-in card and the month view

alt.01-check-in: Check in in one tap: today's card logs your hours with a single click
alt.02-month-at-a-glance: Your month at a glance: hours, days off, bank holidays and pay earned so far
alt.03-fill-missing-days: Fill missed days in one go from a list of past working days
alt.04-days-off: Days off counted right: vacation, sick or unpaid leave over a range of days
alt.05-export: Send your timesheet as Excel or PDF
alt.06-dark-mode: Light, dark, or follow your device
alt.07-private: Private by design: no account, no server, stored on your device, daily backups

features.title: Everything a monthly timesheet needs
features.lead: Built for PFAs and freelancers who bill by the day.

items.title: One tap a day
items.text: Check in from today's card, or open any day to log hours, a half day off, or a whole range of leave. Forgot a few? Fill them all at once.

items.title: Bank holidays, handled
items.text: Each client gets its country's public holidays applied automatically, so your working days are always right.

items.title: Timesheets in Excel or PDF
items.text: Send a clean monthly timesheet to each client. Sent months lock so nothing changes after the fact.

items.title: Multiple clients
items.text: Separate hours, work week, leave and pay for every client. Switch between them from the header.

items.title: Reminders that matter
items.text: A notification on working days you haven't logged, and a monthly one to send your timesheet.

items.title: Private by design
items.text: No account, no server, no tracking. Your data stays on your computer, with daily backups you control.

mac.title: Download
mac.text: Pick your Mac's chip (Apple Silicon for M1 and later, or Intel) and download the .dmg.

mac.title: Drag to Applications
mac.text: Open the .dmg and drag Tivren into your Applications folder.

mac.title: Allow it once
mac.text: Open Tivren. The first time, macOS says it can't verify the app: click Done, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click “Open Anyway”.

windows.title: Download
windows.text: Download the installer (Tivren-Setup-x64.exe). It also runs on Windows on ARM.

windows.title: Allow it once
windows.text: Run it. If SmartScreen says “Windows protected your PC”, click More info → Run anyway.

windows.title: That's it
windows.text: It installs just for you, no admin rights needed, and opens Tivren. Find it later in the Start menu.

items.a: Only on your computer: ~/Library/Application Support/Tivren on a Mac, %APPDATA%\Tivren on Windows. Nothing is sent to a server. Backups are yours to place: choose the folder for daily backups in Settings → Data, and pick where each backup or exported timesheet is saved when you make it. Restore from Settings → Data.
It was built for PFAs and freelancers in Romania (with CUI lookup and Romanian), but bank holidays work for many countries and it's fully in English too.

items.q: Why does my computer warn me when I open it?
items.a: Tivren Timesheet isn't notarized by Apple or signed with a Windows code-signing certificate, which cost money for a free project. macOS asks once (Privacy & Security), and Windows SmartScreen warns once (More info → Run anyway); after that it opens normally.

items.q: Is Tivren Timesheet a commercial product?
items.a: No. It's a personal project, made for fun and shared for free. It isn't sold or meant for commercial use, and support and updates aren't guaranteed. You download and use it at your own risk.
No. Install a newer version over the old one and your data stays where it is.
